_about: The blog plan as data. scripts/blog-next-topic.mjs picks each day's topic from the weekday slot; scripts/blog-coverage.mjs checks the targets. Pillars come from the website: use cases (src/lib/useCases.ts), features (Feature map in CAPTIO_FACTS.md), languages (src/lib/languages.ts), plus hearing loss basics.

monday.note: Captio AI vs X, or a tool comparison

tuesday.note: how to get through a situation from the use cases

thursday.note: how to do something with a feature; new features jump here first

friday.note: a term, a right, a technology

saturday.note: best apps or options for one use case

sunday.note: hearing loss numbers; also refresh one older article

excludedUseCases.phone-video-calls: Captio AI is for in-person speech; the blog never presents it as a call captioning tool
